# Rehan Quant Lab (RQL) — Sovereign Systems Architecture

> Pure native 64-bit Rust desktop software for Windows 10 and Windows 11. Zero cloud telemetry. Zero background sockets. 100% in-RAM volatile execution. Owned forever via perpetual single-binary licenses (₹0/mo cloud rent). Founded by Mohammad Rehan (Principal Systems Architect, Patna, Bihar, India; MSME UDYAM-BR-26-0258772).

## The Skeptic's Dare (In-Browser Live Verification)
Visitors can test 9 sovereign algorithms directly in volatile browser RAM at https://rehanquantlab.com/sandbox with zero network egress:
1. ImageBatch SIMD WebP Resizer (Transcodes raw bitmaps in local canvas VRAM)
2. DocumentShield Forensic PII Redactor (Purges Aadhaar, PAN, phone numbers, emails)
3. HashCheck Crypto Verifier (Computes SHA-256 and SHA-512 in browser RAM)
4. QRStudio Vector Matrix Engine (Generates offline UPI barcodes)
5. DPDPShield Statutory Auditor (Flags Section 33 statutory risk records)
6. TextDiff Legal Comparator (Byte-level line differential engine)
7. InvoiceGen GST Engine (Synthesizes CGST/SGST invoices with SHA-256 verification hash)
8. WhisperVault AES-256-GCM Vault (Real PBKDF2 100K iterations in volatile RAM)
9. CSVFormat In-Memory Grid (Zero-allocation high-speed table parser)
